scripts.install: cd backend && npm i && cd ../admin-frontend && npm i
scripts.install:all: npx concurrently -n root,backend,frontend,shared -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm i" "npm i --prefix backend" "npm i --prefix admin-frontend" "npm i --prefix shared"
scripts.dev: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.backend.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker image prune -f && npm run dev:watch
scripts.dev-rebuild: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.backend.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker image prune -f && npm run dev:watch
scripts.backend:dev: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.backend.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm admin-frontend npm install && docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.backend.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker image prune -f
scripts.prod:up: npm run prod:emqx-config && docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.backend.prod -f ./docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.seed:dev: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed:dev
